reset.comment: Generic restore-to-default action label / a11y description (恢復 = restore). Used by the reset-settings dialog AND reused for the color-picker / slider reset-icon contentDescription on the theme + layout editors.

inputMode.comment: Settings row + sub-screen title for selecting the active input mode. On macOS it labels the picker that chooses between TL and POJ.

displayLanguage.comment: Settings row + sub-screen title for selecting the app UI display language (orthogonal to the input mode). Most option labels are endonyms (own-script, not i18n keys); the Automatic option uses displayLanguageAutomatic.

displayLanguageAutomatic.comment: Display-language picker option that follows the OS/device language (ja->日本語, zh->漢字, else->English). Unlike the other rows this is a translated label, not an endonym.

pojMode.comment: Input-mode option: Pe̍h-ōe-jī (白話字) romanization. Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface).

tlMode.comment: Input-mode option: Tâi-lô (台羅) romanization. Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface).

englishMode.comment: Input-mode option: English keyboard. Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface), and the Windows mode-flash label when a Shift tap switches to English input.

taigiMode.comment: Windows mode-flash label when a Shift tap switches back from English to Taigi input. Pairs with englishMode.

tpsMode.comment: Input-mode option: Taiwanese Phonetic Symbols (方音符號). Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface).

candidateDisplayMode.comment: Picker label: how a candidate cell renders the (漢字, 羅馬字) pair — side by side (today) or romanization only. Host settings + iOS/Android in-keyboard settings overlay; desktop appearance pane.

candidateDisplayModeSideBySide.comment: Picker value (default): cell shows hanji and romanization as primary + secondary; the 文/A key decides which leads.

candidateDisplayModeCombined.comment: Picker value: cell shows hanji and romanization as ONE label (漢字 羅馬字); committing writes the hanji; the 文/A key is inert. TL/POJ only.

candidateDisplayModeRomanOnly.comment: Picker value: cell shows the romanization only; committing writes the romanization; TL/POJ only.

outputBothScripts.comment: Toggle label: annotate committed text with the other script in brackets.

literalRomanCandidate.comment: Toggle label: show what is being typed as the first candidate in the strip (§34 literal-roman candidate). All four platforms.

literalRomanCandidateInfo.comment: Help text for the 顯示當咧拍的字 toggle.

values.hanji: 佇候選詞列第一格顯示你拍 ê 羅馬字，會當點揤抑是揤 Enter 送出。關閉了後干焦會當用 Enter 送出。
values.tailo: tī hāu-suán sû lia̍t tē-it keh hián-sī lí phah ê lô-má-jī, ē-tàng tiám-tshi̍h ah-sī tshi̍h Enter sàng-tshut. kuainn--khí-lâi liáu-āu kan-ta ē-tàng iōng Enter sàng-tshut.
values.poj: tī hāu-soán sû lia̍t tē-it keh hián-sī lí phah ê lô-má-jī, ē-tàng tiám-chhi̍h ah-sī chhi̍h Enter sàng-chhut. koaiⁿ--khí-lâi liáu-āu kan-ta ē-tàng iōng Enter sàng-chhut.
values.en: Shows what you typed in the first slot of the candidate bar. Tap it or press Enter to commit it. When off, only Enter can commit it.
values.ja: 入力したローマ字を候補バーの先頭に表示します。タップするか Enter で確定できます。オフの場合は Enter でのみ確定できます。

autoCapitalization.comment: Toggle label: automatic capitalization in English mode.

autoSpace.comment: Toggle label: auto-insert a space after committing a word.

shiftTogglesEnglish.comment: Toggle label: tap Shift on its own to switch between Taigi and English input (the Windows CJK convention). Windows only — macOS reaches English through the system Caps Lock input-source switch.

values.ja: Shift で英語に切り替え

toolbarAutoCollapse.comment: Toggle label: automatically collapse the candidate toolbar after selecting a word.

values.hanji: 選字後自動收合工具列
values.tailo: suán jī liáu-āu tsū-tōng siu-ha̍p kang-khū-lia̍t
values.poj: soán jī liáu-āu chū-tōng siu-ha̍p kang-khū-lia̍t
values.ja: 候補選択後にツールバーを折りたたむ

toolbarAutoCollapseInfo.comment: Help text for the auto-hide-toolbar toggle.

values.hanji: 選字了後工具列會自動合起來，予齒盤面頂空間較大。
values.tailo: suán jī liáu-āu kang-khū-lia̍t huē tsū-tōng ha̍p--khí-lâi, hōo khí-puânn bīn-tíng khang-king khah-tōa.
values.poj: soán jī liáu-āu kang-khū-lia̍t hōe chū-tōng ha̍p--khí-lâi, hō͘ khí-pôaⁿ bīn-téng khang-keng khah-tōa.
values.en: After you pick a word, the toolbar collapses automatically to give the keyboard more room.
values.ja: 単語を選ぶとツールバーが自動的に閉じ、キーボードの表示領域が広くなります。

globeKey.comment: Toggle label: show the globe / keyboard-switch key.

globeKeyInfo.comment: Help text for the globe-key toggle.

values.hanji: 佇齒盤面頂加 1 粒地球揤鈕，揤著會使切換去其他齒盤。
values.tailo: tī khí-puânn bīn-tíng ka 1 lia̍p tuē-kiû tshi̍h-liú, tshi̍h tio̍h ē-sái tshiat-uānn khì kî-thann khí-puânn.
values.poj: tī khí-pôaⁿ bīn-téng ka 1 lia̍p tōe-kiû chhi̍h-liú, chhi̍h tio̍h ē-sái chhiat-ōaⁿ khì kî-thaⁿ khí-pôaⁿ.
values.en: Adds a globe key to the keyboard; tap it to switch to another keyboard.
values.ja: キーボードに地球儀キーを追加します。タップすると他のキーボードに切り替えられます。

feedbackSectionTitle.comment: Section header for key-press feedback settings.

doubleTapOO.comment: Toggle label: double-tap oo composes o͘ (POJ).

values.ja: oo を続けて入力 → o͘

doubleTapNN.comment: Toggle label: double-tap nn composes ⁿ (POJ nasal).

values.ja: nn を続けて入力 → ⁿ

tpsOrMapsToER.comment: Toggle label: render TL 'or' final as TPS ㄜ.

values.ja: or を ㄜ に対応

tpsOrMapsToERInfo.comment: Help text for the or→ㄜ toggle (multi-paragraph).

values.hanji: 控制方音符號候選詞按怎顯示 or。開啟時顯示做 ㄜ，關閉時顯示做 ㄛ。這个設定袂影響揣詞結果。
values.tailo: khòng-tsè hong-im-hû-hō hāu-suán sû án-nuá hián-sī or. phah-khui sî hián-sī tsò ㄜ, kuainn--khí-lâi sî hián-sī tsò ㄛ. tsit ê siat-tīng buē íng-hióng tshuē sû kiat-kó.
values.poj: khòng-chè hong-im-hû-hō hāu-soán sû án-nóa hián-sī or. phah-khui sî hián-sī chò ㄜ, koaiⁿ--khí-lâi sî hián-sī chò ㄛ. chit ê siat-tēng bōe éng-hióng chhōe sû kiat-kó.
values.en: Controls how TPS candidates display 'or'. When on, 'or' appears as ㄜ; when off, it appears as ㄛ. This setting does not affect search results.
values.ja: 方音符号の候補で「or」をどう表示するかを設定します。オンでは ㄜ、オフでは ㄛ と表示します。検索結果には影響しません。

resetSettings.comment: Destructive action row + dialog title: reset all settings and delete frequency/association records; custom words are preserved.

values.ja: 設定と利用記録をリセット

resetSettingsMessage.comment: Confirmation-dialog body for resetting settings and deleting frequency/association records; explicitly states that custom words are preserved.

values.hanji: 這會恢復所有設定，嘛會刪除詞頻佮詞關聯紀錄。自訂詞會保留。敢欲繼續？
values.tailo: tse ē hue-ho̍k sóo-iú siat-tīng, mā ē san-tû sû pîn kah sû kuan-liân kì-lio̍k. tsū-tīng-sû ē pó-liû. kám beh kè-sio̍k?
values.poj: che ē hoe-ho̍k só͘-iú siat-tēng, mā ē san-tû sû pîn kah sû koan-liân kì-lio̍k. chū-tēng-sû ē pó-liû. kám beh kè-sio̍k?
values.en: This resets all settings and deletes frequency and association records. Custom words are kept. Continue?
values.ja: すべての設定をリセットし、単語頻度と単語連携の記録を削除します。カスタム単語は保持されます。続けますか？

resetSuccess.comment: Toast shown after settings were reset successfully.

values.ja: 設定をリセットしました

resetFailed.comment: Toast shown when resetting settings fails.

values.en: Failed to reset settings. Please try again.
values.ja: 設定のリセットに失敗しました。もう一度お試しください。

noEmailApp.comment: Toast shown when no email app is available to send the bug report.

values.ja: メールアプリが見つかりません

diagnosticCopy.comment: Action row: copy device diagnostic info to clipboard.

values.ja: デバイス情報をコピー

diagnosticCopied.comment: Toast confirming diagnostic info was copied.

diagnosticShare.comment: Action row: share device diagnostic info via the share sheet.

diagnosticEmail.comment: Action row: email a bug report with diagnostic info attached.

openApp.comment: Keyboard-overlay button linking to the host app's full settings screen.
